Highly recommend Pawsitivity! They offer home grooming services, and my dog Melissa Maria absolutely loved the special experience. The care, patience, and professionalism were exceptional. If you’re looking for stress-free grooming in the comfort of your own home, this is the perfect choice!

Carlos was extremely understanding about our particular situation which we were very grateful for. He greeted our puppy so well and put her at ease. He took a great deal of time to groom her and the results were wonderful. She came out looking like a new puppy. We would highly recommend Carlos.

I recently booked my Ragdoll cat in with Pawsitivity for what was supposed to be a simple trim of matted fur around his hip. Unfortunately, it turned into a complete disaster: my cat was shaved down to the skin, despite my explicit attempt to show the groomer exactly where the matting was.

The groomer arrived an hour late, then rushed through the session—finishing exactly at the original end time. In later text messages, they claimed I had requested “all his fur off,” which is absurd. I was pointing to my hip the entire time, indicating only the specific matted area. If they truly believed I meant a full shave, why did they not confirm that critical point on the spot?

When I questioned this, they essentially blamed me for not being clearer. The groomer also dismissed winter temperatures as “irrelevant,” which I find outrageous. As a Ragdoll owner, I would never intentionally leave my cat exposed to freezing weather without his natural coat. My cat is now visibly cold and anxious, constantly seeking warm spots around the house.

In short, the communication was appalling, the service unprofessional, and my instructions completely ignored. Based on this disastrous outcome, I strongly advise any caring pet owner to look elsewhere for grooming services. My experience with Pawsitivity was deeply distressing, and my cat is the one who’s paid the price.
